about.title: Money makes more sense when you practice it
about.body1: Most finance courses explain theory and expect you to apply it on your own, with no safe place to get it wrong. Here you can make budgeting, debt, and investing decisions inside a game, see the result, and try again as many times as you want.
about.body2: All the content —games and books— is free and stays on this site. Nothing is downloaded or forwarded: it's played and read here, and discussed in the community.
footer.tagline: Financial education to play, read, and talk about.

community.guidelines.body: Be respectful, avoid sharing personal financial data (account numbers, exact debt amounts, etc.), and remember comments are public.
